# Wave warp

Bends the image along travelling sine waves, horizontally, vertically or both, like a flag in the wind or a reflection in water.

<EffectDemo effect="wave-warp" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { waveWarp } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/wave-warp';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(waveWarp({ preset: 'flag' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.axis = 'horizontal'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                 | Default        | Range     | Description                       |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------ | -------------- | --------- | --------------------------------- |
| `axis`      | 'horizontal' \| 'vertical' \| 'both' | `'horizontal'` |           | Which way the image is pushed.    |
| `amplitude` | number                               | `10`           | 0 – 80 px | Height of the waves.              |
| `frequency` | number                               | `4`            | 0.5 – 40  | Waves across the frame height.    |
| `speed`     | number                               | `0.5`          | 0 – 4     | Waves per second passing a point. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset         | Settings                                                          |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `flag`         | `axis: 'vertical'`, `amplitude: 14`, `frequency: 2`, `speed: 0.6` |
| `underwater`   | `axis: 'both'`, `amplitude: 6`, `frequency: 6`, `speed: 0.4`      |
| `jelly`        | `axis: 'both'`, `amplitude: 24`, `frequency: 1.5`, `speed: 0.3`   |
| `interference` | `amplitude: 3`, `frequency: 30`, `speed: 0`                       |

Apply one with `waveWarp({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Distortion & warp · tracked as story X9.4 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Cost:** 0.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 5.5 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/wave-warp`, including the shared effect runtime.
